claim_boundary: Fresh final-source compatibility for the exact pre-existing ordinary sigma-intercept route only; the offset arc changes the model-15 linear predictor to eta_mu = offset_mu + X_mu * beta_mu, which is inert when no offset is supplied, and the merged link_code and MSPL work sits outside the authenticated model-15 anchors, and no zero-one-beta cell is promoted. Re-certified 2026-08-11 after the MSPL Jeffreys working weight in src/drmTMB.cpp was made link-dispatching via drm_binom_log_mu()/drm_binom_log_mu_eta(), with the logit branch kept verbatim so the shipped route is bit-identical, plus the matching link threading in R/mspl-estimator.R. Both sit outside the authenticated model-15 anchors, and the MSPL estimator is unreachable for zero-one-beta in any case. Measured behaviour was reproduced exactly (|change| 0.000e+00 on all three cells), so nothing these cells certify has moved and no claim is widened.
